content.user_title: Humanize AI-Sounding Copy Without Losing Voice
content.value_statement: Generic AI patterns can make useful writing sound inflated and impersonal. This skill edits or audits drafts while preserving meaning, facts, tone, and individual voice.
actual_capabilities: Edits AI-sounding prose with the minimum changes needed for clarity and natural rhythm.
Audits drafts without rewriting them when the user requests detection mode.
Identifies named patterns and provides quoted evidence with concise fixes.
Preserves supported facts, meaning, formality, opinions, vocabulary, and voice signals.
Applies a repeatable final evaluation and removes Unicode em dashes from outputs.
limitations: Works only on text and context supplied in the conversation.
Cannot verify factual accuracy or find missing sources without separate research.
Does not determine whether AI authored a draft.
Enforces a strict no-em-dash rule even when the original style uses that punctuation.

use_cases.title: Refine a personal draft
use_cases.description: Clean up robotic phrasing while keeping the writer's vocabulary, humor, uncertainty, and level of formality.

use_cases.title: Improve marketing copy
use_cases.description: Remove promotional fog, generic claims, filler, and repetitive structures from product or campaign copy.

use_cases.title: Audit submitted content
use_cases.description: Flag named writing patterns with evidence and fixes without replacing the original draft.

prompt_templates.title: Clean a short paragraph
prompt_templates.prompt:
Deslop this paragraph. Preserve its meaning and tone. Return only the cleaned text:

[PASTE TEXT]
prompt_templates.scenario: A beginner wants a direct edit with no commentary.

prompt_templates.title: Audit without rewriting
prompt_templates.prompt:
Audit this draft for AI-writing patterns. Name each pattern, quote the evidence, and suggest a concise fix. Do not rewrite the draft:

[PASTE TEXT]
prompt_templates.scenario: A reviewer wants findings before deciding which edits to accept.

prompt_templates.title: Preserve a defined voice
prompt_templates.prompt:
Edit this draft with a light touch. Preserve my [FORMALITY], [VOICE TRAITS], and technical terms. Remove filler and unsupported emphasis:

[PASTE TEXT]
prompt_templates.scenario: A writer has clear voice requirements and domain terminology.

prompt_templates.title: Run an advanced editorial pass
prompt_templates.prompt:
First audit the draft internally. Then revise only supported issues while preserving facts, structure, and intentional rough edges. Return the final text:

[PASTE TEXT]
prompt_templates.scenario: An experienced editor wants a complete review with restrained revision.

output_examples.input: Our groundbreaking platform leverages robust technology to empower teams and drive transformative outcomes.
output_examples.output: Our platform helps teams coordinate work and complete projects.

output_examples.input: Audit this line without rewriting it: This pivotal solution stands as a testament to innovation.
output: Empty significance: "pivotal" claims importance without showing why. Add a concrete result or remove it.
Fake-strong verb: "stands as a testament" inflates a simple claim. State what the solution does.

best_practices: Provide the complete draft so the skill can preserve context, structure, and recurring voice signals.
State the audience, format, and desired formality when those details affect the edit.
Use detect mode when you want evidence and recommendations before accepting changes.
anti_patterns: Do not ask the skill to invent facts, statistics, sources, examples, or opinions.
Do not use detection findings as proof that AI authored the text.
Do not request a complete rewrite when preserving the writer's existing voice is essential.

faq.question: What types of text can this skill edit?
faq.answer: It can edit articles, emails, documentation, marketing copy, posts, and other prose supplied in the conversation.

faq.question: Can it audit text without changing it?
faq.answer: Yes. Detect mode names each supported pattern, quotes the relevant evidence, and suggests a concise fix.

faq.question: Will it preserve my writing voice?
faq.answer: It is designed to preserve vocabulary, cadence, humor, uncertainty, opinions, and formality when the draft supports them.

faq.question: Can it prove that a draft was written by AI?
faq.answer: No. It identifies writing patterns but does not make authorship claims or provide an AI probability score.

faq.question: Does it check facts and sources?
faq.answer: It avoids inventing facts and flags vague attribution, but factual verification requires separate research.

faq.question: Why does the skill remove every em dash?
faq.answer: The skill defines zero em dashes as a hard output rule and replaces them with other punctuation or revised sentences.
